subject: [PATCH 1/4] mm/damon: defensively skip zone device folios in damon_get_folio()

2026-07-29.patch_summary: This patch series adds missing checks for ZONE_DEVICE memory in various mm walkers, ensuring that zone device folios are not lazily freed or aged prematurely. The changes aim to harden the kernel by making these checks consistent across different walkers and providing a clear indication of when zone device interactions occur.
